title: MobileLinux Device Definition
description: Declarative definition of a phone/tablet: identity, SoC, kernel, device-tree, firmware, hardware status, boot, install/flash strategy, OTA capabilities and hardware tests. This is the single source of truth for a device; adding a new device should mostly mean adding one of these files plus assets.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file targets. Bump when the schema changes incompatibly.

id.description: Short unique id, usually the codename (e.g. 'rhodep').

aliases.description: Other names this device is known by (marketing names, alt codenames).

vendor.description: SoC vendor: qualcomm, allwinner, samsung, nxp, mediatek, ...

kernel.description: Kernel = shared hardware-support base (patches/DTB/base config) plus per-distro CONFIG deltas ('flavors'). The same device supports multiple distros by swapping only the config flavor; patches and DTB are identical. This mirrors the reference port where pmOS and Kali share 108 byte-identical patches and differ only in the .config.

type.description: mainline = torvalds/linux; stable = x.y.z stable tree; downstream/vendor = forked BSP kernel.

source.description: Git URL or tarball URL of the kernel source.

provider.description: The device-support provider: where the shared kernel work (aport = APKBUILD + patches + DTB + base config + deviceinfo) comes from. Usually postmarketOS. If the device is NOT yet in official pmaports, point 'source' at the porter's own fork/repo.

kind.description: postmarketos = a pmaports-style aport built with pmbootstrap; custom = same layout but from a non-upstream repo; none = built directly (make).

upstreamed.description: True only if the device is merged into official pmaports. False = use the fork/repo in 'source'.

source.description: Git URL of the aport source (official pmaports, OR the porter's fork/repo, e.g. https://github.com/<user>/postmarketos-<codename>).

pmaports_ref.description: If upstreamed or an MR exists: the pmaports path/branch, e.g. 'device/testing/device-motorola-rhodep' or a fork branch.

aport_dir.description: Path (relative to device dir) to the migrated shared aport assets (APKBUILD, base config, patches, deviceinfo).

linux_pkg.description: The linux-* package name in pmaports, e.g. 'linux-motorola-rhodep'. This is the package pmbootstrap builds and the one swapped in the active aport dir.

base_config.description: Path (relative to device dir) to the shared BASE kernel config (the provider/pmOS-clean config). Flavors are fragments merged onto this.

patches_dir.description: Path (relative to device dir) to the ordered *.patch files shared by ALL flavors.

flavors.description: Per-distro kernel flavors. Each is a small CONFIG DELTA (fragment) merged onto base_config, NOT a full config. This keeps the delta auditable and prevents drift between two 12k-line configs.

config_fragment.description: Path (relative to device dir) to the Kconfig fragment merged onto base_config for this flavor (e.g. a NetHunter fragment for Kali). May be empty-ish for the base/pmos flavor.

distros.description: Which distros use this flavor, e.g. ['kali','debian'] or ['postmarketos'].

discriminator.description: A symbol whose presence proves this flavor's config is the active one (e.g. RT2800USB=m for Kali, absent for pmOS). Used to verify the correct aport is loaded before building.

present.description: Whether the symbol must be present (set) for this flavor.

method.description: How the kernel image is produced. 'pmbootstrap' reuses a pmaports APKBUILD (the provider aport).

image.description: Which arch/*/boot image to use. Some bootloaders (Motorola ABL) require flat 'Image', not 'Image.gz'.

deb_package.description: If true, the built kernel apk is repackaged into a Debian linux-image .deb for debian-based distros (Kali/Debian/Ubuntu) consumed by debos.

dtb.description: DTB filename produced by the kernel build, e.g. 'sm6375-motorola-rhodep.dtb'.

append_dtb.description: If true, DTB is concatenated to the kernel Image (Android append_dtb). Required by some Motorola bootloaders.

redistributable.description: False if blobs are proprietary and must be extracted from the device (not shipped in git).

package.description: Name of the firmware package, e.g. 'firmware-motorola-rhodep'.

provides.description: Which subsystems the firmware serves: wifi, bluetooth, gpu, modem, adsp, cdsp, audio, nfc, display.

extract_from_device.description: Blobs that must be extracted from the running/stock device (non-redistributable).

source.description: Where on the stock device it lives (partition/path).

dest.description: Where it must land in the rootfs firmware tree.

runtime_mounts.description: Partitions mounted read-only at runtime to serve firmware (e.g. modem_a for the .mbn/.bNN blobs).

hardware.description: Per-feature support status. Statuses MUST be evidence-based. Never claim 'supported' without a passing test or documented evidence.

device_packages.description: Device-specific packages/config that make the hardware work (the declarative form of the old rhodep-*.deb and userspace installers). These are applied on top of any distro rootfs.

layer.description: Reuse scope: generic=any phone, soc=same SoC family, vendor=same manufacturer, device=this device only. Maps to audit classes A/B/C/D.

purpose.description: One line: what breaks if this is absent.

source.description: Path (relative to device or shared layer dir) to the package source / installer.

critical.description: If true, must be present for a usable phone (radio/boot/display).

first_boot.description: Actions applied on first boot (the declarative form of the manual 'first boot fixes').

mask_services.description: systemd units to mask, e.g. droid-juicer.service, systemd-repart.service.

resize_rootfs.description: Grow the root filesystem to fill its partition on first boot.

android_bootimg.description: Parameters for building an Android boot image (when method=android-bootimg).

cmdline.description: Kernel command line baked into the boot image.

modules.description: Kernel modules needed in the initramfs (e.g. spi_geni_qcom, goodix_berlin for touch).

storage.description: Storage / partition facts needed by install and OTA.

rootfs_layout.description: 'gpt-in-partition' = the rootfs image is itself a GPT disk written inside an Android partition (rhodep userdata case).

rootfs_sector_size.description: Logical sector size of the rootfs image (UFS devices use 4096).

partitions.description: Named partitions relevant to install/OTA (NOT a full GPT dump).

writable_via.description: Which mechanisms are ALLOWED to write this partition on this device. rhodep userdata: ['dd'] only (fastboot denied).

install.description: How the device is installed/flashed. This is a first-class, per-device concern. Do NOT assume fastboot userdata works.

strategy.description: The installation strategy. Each maps to an installer backend. Chosen from strategies observed on REAL devices.

ab_slots.description: Does the device use Android A/B slots?

fastbootd.description: Does the device have fastbootd (userspace fastboot)?

boot_partition.description: Partition the boot image is flashed to, e.g. 'boot_a', 'boot', 'BOOT'.

partition.description: Partition that receives the rootfs image, e.g. 'userdata'.

rescue.description: Optional rescue/debug environment used to write partitions the bootloader won't (and reused for recovery).

boot_image.description: Asset path of the prebuilt rescue image, or 'build' to build it.

build_from.description: Base boot image the rescue image is derived from.

transport.description: How the host reaches the rescue env, e.g. 'telnet://172.16.42.1:23', 'ssh://user@172.16.42.1'.

steps.description: Ordered, declarative install steps. The installer backend interprets these; they are NOT raw shell for arbitrary devices.

command.description: For run-remote: command executed inside the rescue/OS env.

ota.description: Over-the-air update capabilities. Declares what the hardware allows; the framework degrades gracefully.

type.description: How slot selection / boot success is recorded. android-bootctl uses the Android misc partition (qbootctl).

updatable.description: Which components an OTA may update on this device.

bootloader.description: Almost always false; never auto-update bootloader without an extremely clear, safe mechanism.

tests.description: Which hardware test modules apply to this device (see testing/tests/).

sources.description: Provenance: where this device support comes from.

status.description: supported=works; partial=works with caveats; broken=present but breaks/unsafe; untested=no evidence; unsupported=won't work on mainline; not-present=device lacks the hardware.

weight.description: Relative importance for the overall support percentage. Core features (display/boot) weigh more.

driver.description: Kernel driver / mechanism, e.g. 'msm-dsi + NT37701 panel', 'ath10k_snoc'.

evidence.description: Where the status comes from (doc path, test name, wiki). REQUIRED in spirit for 'supported'.

test.description: Name of the test module that verifies this feature.
